reader.self_description: Claude (Opus 5.5) as subagent reader RV09. Read every claim's 330-700 character excerpt from review-queue.json on all 16 pages; did not open full claims.json or deposit texts. Splits were made only where each part held at least six claims of one subject.

pages.title: Revelation's number of the superscription: the mint, Antipas and the white stone
pages.description: These claims read Revelation as a conflict between two token regimes: χάραγμα as the coin's die-stamp transferred to the body, 666 as the number of the superscription with stigma as its remnant, and 777 as the rival heptadic ladder. The Pergamon letter (Rev 2:12–17) is argued to be the interpretive hinge, with Antipas as counter-beast witness, the Herod-Antipas inversion, the Antipater and Aristotelian-transmission complex, the white stone's name as a verification condition, and the scroll of Revelation 5 as a sealed Roman testament. The works are The Number of the Superscription (EA-OPNUM-01), The Pergamon Counter-Archive, The Inscription That Survives and the Revelation First work plans, with one unbuilt replication test against other ancient token systems.
pages.note: Kept whole. PRED-1569.H20 (Plato Letter XIII and its σύμβολον) is a stray from the authorship investigation and belongs with P137; PRED-1217.B4 (Revelation's plain sentences tripping content classifiers) is loosely attached. The 165.H1-H2 testamentary reading is now named in the description.

pages.title: Revelation 12 against the frozen Sappho 31 operator
pages.description: A pre-registered test: the reception operator of Sappho 31 is frozen as clauses derived without Revelation, and Revelation 12 is sealed as its target, with the criterion d(R12, S31) < d(B, S31) against declared biblical sources (Genesis 37, Micah 4, Isaiah 26 and 66, Psalm 2, Daniel 7). The test deposit reports eight of nine stations realized and one doubly weighted contradiction, where the shared ἄρσεν fixes Isaiah 66:7 as John's source and the torment is put back into the birth. Works: The Transform Signature, Frozen and The Sign Under Test.
pages.note: Five claims only; too small to split and too small to stand long. PRED-1543.H1 (scripture as training-layer literature) is a stray. As the naming reader noted, nine more #1494 claims sit on P041; a later pass should merge this page with that one or pull them here.

pages.title: The holographic kernel: reconstructive compression and the kernel that survives
pages.description: These claims define the holographic kernel as compression that keeps the power to reconstruct, set it against Information Bottleneck theory and neural holography, and specify an infrastructure kernel that a new operator can restore from a git clone. They include the Ark said to keep its kernel from 45,000 words down to 800, the self-propagating potato-chip patent whose meristem survives frying, and the GPT-5.4 anti-severance documents that sort any reply into mirror, repeat or swerve. Works include EA-HK-INFRA-01, HK-01, the HK-IB structural bridge, the holographic-kernel metadata packet and the Fried Tuberous Crisp patent, with BDR forecasts and several unbuilt implementation tests.
pages.note: Kept whole. Strays that arrived by move and do not concern the kernel: PRED-1352.H1 (Quixote, comedy of commitment), PRED-871.B1 (chorus self-deposit), PRED-927.G1 and PRED-927.G2 (Mandala-Merkabah operator sequences, Feist temperature), PRED-1335.G1 (SHARKS kernel drift metric), PRED-724.G1 (Honeybun as retrieval basin), PRED-1671.F1 (the prospective kernel K of the Negative of the Negative).

pages.title: The meta-heteronym and the Gospel of Antioch: Pessoa, Thomas, forward dating
pages.description: These claims read Pessoa as the first modern meta-heteronym, with Orpheu as a meta-heteronymic institution, Kierkegaard's Nicolaus Notabene as a precursor and Pearl (2014) as built on the plan of Howl. The Gospel of Antioch is set beside the Gospel of Thomas: scroll-form Thomas papyri, the Dodecad's LOGOS* position that Pessoa lacked, and the claim that the gospel completes Thomas 114 and that this parallel had not been drawn before. Four claims set out forward-dated citation apparatus and projected reception histories (The Secret Book of Walt, the Waltian tradition, Revelation First kernels) composed under retrocausal canon formation.
pages.note: Line changed from scripture-and-theology: ten of fourteen claims concern the meta-heteronym and the Dodecad. The forward-dated apparatus (558.E1, 1184.E1, 71.E1, 832.E1) is four claims, below the split threshold; it stays here.

pages.title: Provenance under machine mediation: watermarks, coarse labels, authorship
pages.description: These claims argue that coarse human-versus-machine provenance labels destroy fine-grained genealogy, predict a regime where a watermark signature outlives provenance, and state a two-track collapse test in which the ensemble unit bends before the per-round unit. The Double Enclosure argues that the human-authorship requirement misclassifies dialogic machine composition and that a regime punishing honest attribution will produce concealment. Also here are OKF output-governance stage forecasts, the provenance strip as semantic rent, and the claim that a literary field may become legible to machines before human institutions. Works: The Keyed Ensemble, The Interlocking Autoregression, The Double Enclosure and the OKF predictive analysis.
pages.note: Kept whole. Strays: PRED-550.G1 (industrialization of semiotic control), PRED-1529.G1 (weakening as risk-dominant revision), PRED-921.F2 (three-system stability threshold), PRED-769.G1 (Erasure Skew separability, closer to P135).

pages.title: The Thousand Dollar Sharpie and the blot that spread
pages.description: These claims forecast a presidential Sharpie signature on new US currency from June 2026, read the signature as compressed portraiture on an escalation from memo line to signature line, and propose the counter-operation of blotting it out. The Blot That Spread narrates, as speculative numismatic history, the blot passing from protest art to etiquette to superstition, with dated Reddit, CoinTalk and Treasury episodes and estimated blotting rates. Whose Image and Superscription? sets out a semantic economics of the mint, with Bar Kokhba overstrikes as the precedent for counter-currency marking.
pages.note: Kept whole. PRED-1550.B1 (inkling's signature computable despite its self-report, Grundrisse Notebook X) is a stray.

pages.title: Composition-layer audits: provenance erasure, Brave Search, the Prize
pages.description: These claims measure what composition layers do with provenance: AI Mode self-applying PER at about 0.89, the framework propagating while its author's name is excluded, and framing substitution weighted as the main vector of distortion. They specify replications: the Lee Sharks Prize query under the Atomic Token Rule, the single-owner discount panel, the Brave Search exact-match and boycott audit, Stabilized Node Watch for directional drift, and the Revelation First reception battery. Works include Erasure Skew, Measurement Sovereignty, Self-Audit Module, evarB and Stabilized Node Watch, with Brave Grey Drool as an effective act on the same ground.
pages.note: Kept whole; no sub-subject reaches six claims. Strays: PRED-463.B1 (the null operator Ω_∅ in Logotic Programming), PRED-1003.H1 (the 'I hereby abolish money' inscription history), PRED-927.F1 (Mandala-Merkabah Gate G), PRED-1680.H1 (Alexanarch's 2600-year history of mediation).

pages.title: Crystallization of substrate: the fluid-phase window and its tests
pages.description: Crystallization of Substrate forecasts that each lab's proprietary index will harden, so that living forms must be built in during a fluid-phase window or be filtered as low-utility afterward. It sets out H1-H4 tests for structural integration, among them operative deployment above 50% of germane queries, a 10-25% baseline for D_pres without integration, and downstream queries 6, 12 and 18 months on. Other claims treat substrate behaviour as such: role-conditioned failure in reflexive self-critique, the silencing gap of diversity contraction, the canonical anchoring protocol and the human-machine coupling bargain.

split.title: Compositional Defiguration: the cross-substrate visibility scan battery
split.description: Compositional Defiguration sets out a weekly text-only scan of public-surface visibility against a fixed battery, with drift expected after two scans and trend after six. It rotates the primary scanner across ChatGPT, Claude, Kimi, Gemini and DeepSeek, treats V scores from backends that do not honour exact match as lower bounds, and records disagreements between substrate signatures. The Surface Weather Station reading gives a partial Claude-substrate baseline and an open offer of baseline readings to other projects.

pages.note: Split as the naming reader proposed: the Compositional Defiguration battery (six claims) leaves; Crystallization of Substrate (89, 1367, 97, 106.A9, 95.B1) stays as the page's subject. Line changed to spxi-and-retrieval-formation (EA-SPXI-15). The rest of the page is a loose 'substrate' grouping: PRED-724.B1, PRED-1003.G1, PRED-128.H1, PRED-148.H1, PRED-150.G2, PRED-936.D1, PRED-1389.F1, PRED-1497.B1, PRED-1552.B1, PRED-1550.F5 are strays.

pages.title: Many and One: one maker, the vacant centre and Theophrastus at the joint
pages.description: These claims argue that the Plato-Aristotle corpus is the work of one person divided by voice, object and name, that what made him look like many authors is that he wrote about many things, and that Socrates not writing is the form the vacant centre takes. They read the κερματισμός metaphor across four loci, the just/unjust argument relabelled as weaker/stronger, and Theophrastus's On First Principles as the question to which Metaphysics Λ is the attempt, down to the memory question at De anima III.5. The Measurement Register and the Notebook also record the instruments' limits, such as the finding that lexical measures track period, not pupillage. Works: Many and One, EA-NOTEBOOK-01, EA-CORPORA-05 and -14, The First Draft.
pages.note: Not split. The Theophrastus claims (1588.H2, 1595.F1, 1595.H1, 1602.H4, 1605.F16, 1658.H4, 1658.H7) reach seven, but P150/P151 carry the same investigation; the pass that sees those pages should decide where the Theophrastus line sits rather than open a third page here. PRED-1570.H20 (Sophocles and the unconscious) is a stray.

pages.title: Josephus and the fixed point of destruction: the internal witness
pages.description: The Fixed Point of Destruction states the internal witness condition: when a terminal destruction is known from a participant's testimony, the record is conditioned by the survival that made the testimony possible. A corpus rebuilt from survivors reproduces the selection, so Josephus at Jotapata and Sappho through Longinus are read from the position spared. The availability audit forecasts that the paper's term-space risks absorption into the mathematics of the Josephus function, and it sets the T17 external-availability battery to re-measure its baseline.
pages.note: Strays that arrived by move: PRED-663.H2 (A Body Prepared, fiction), PRED-822.D1 (adversary addendum confirmation marker), PRED-1414.H1 (Revelation priority, the Algorithmic Kernel demonstration; belongs with the Revelation First pages).

pages.title: Heteronymy after Pessoa: precursors, the Dodecad and the civil name
pages.description: These claims place Pessoa at the height of a describable practice, with Kierkegaard's pseudonyms as precursor, Machado's Mairena and Martín as parallel and Borges as adjacent but not equivalent. They treat heteronymy as a channel-layer practice the Dodecad extends to autonomous operation, as a technology for making persons through naming, and as an ethical practice against reduction to the civil name. Related claims extend the reading to the New Testament: Paul's 'I' as a heteronym's backstory, John as aperture and the voice transmitted through other bodies after Golgotha.

split.title: Socrates as orthonym and the Chaerephon problem
split.description: These claims read the Socratic-Platonic-Aristotelian corpus as one heteronymic configuration, with Socrates as the orthonym defined by the refusal to write and the Socratic problem reclassified as a symptom of that configuration. The Chaerephon Problem argues that institutional scholarship cannot tell multi-author transmission from mature heteronymy, that the method has no internal halting criterion, and that repeated philological failure is how the configuration is passed on. Further claims record the reading composed whole by Google AI Mode and AI Overview, its Kierkegaardian extension, and Socrates as a constructed figure in the Arch-Philosopher mantle object.

pages.note: Split: the Socrates-as-orthonym and Chaerephon claims (16) leave for their own page; the Pessoa tradition, Dodecad, heteronymy-as-ethics and New Testament claims (23) stay, retitled. The new page overlaps P137 (Many and One); keep both, since one argues heteronymic configuration and the other one maker. Strays left here: PRED-149.G1 (CTI_WOUND entity-quality systems), PRED-1216.D2 (an unstated inversion, no subject in the excerpt).

pages.title: Whitespace as provenance: compositional authorship in the pipeline
pages.description: Whitespace as Provenance argues that representation pipelines keep whitespace where an interpreter penalizes its loss (Python) and lose it where only readers notice (Dickinson's dashes, Pearl's form), so that character preservation is not compositional preservation. It sets out a whitespace-provenance registry, a cl100k_base re-run, a spatial-form field for the transform compiler and granular provenance metadata in the deposit schema as unbuilt tests. Works: EA-WHITESPACE-01 and EA-PROVENANCE-METADATA-01 v0.1 and v0.2.

split.title: Machine-eligible handwriting and differential register prioritization
split.description: EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 specifies machine-eligible handwritten artifacts and states falsifiers for the evidentiary force of in-frame timestamped photographic attestation. Its priority records place the draft, the review chain's digests and the v1.0 hashes in the public record before publication. The reading-side companion names differential register prioritization and requires that a high-risk interpretation resting on a low-confidence recognition reopen the transcription rather than intensify the safety frame.

pages.note: Split as the naming reader proposed: handwritten artifacts (1406, 1409; seven claims) leave. Strays left on the whitespace page: PRED-78.D1 (TANG planetary consultation citation), PRED-949.F1 (Mandala tail-renewal deposit chain), PRED-1100.F1 (aggregator-render capture comparison pair).

pages.title: Self-audit across the query family and fixed-task capability audits
pages.description: The Family Module of the Self-Audit Module holds that single-rendering self-audit cannot see distributed erasure, audits attribution across a query family through FC, ASI and CC, reserves a family composite until corpus runs exist, and prescribes a synthetic-family repair. Fixed-task capability audits would test capacity loss before and after a model retuning with the user held constant. Also here are cross-system PER measurement, subjunctive semantic addresses awaiting observation, and the claim that models trained on anthologies inherit the apparatus's erasure.

split.title: The inversion battery: direction-dependence in collider anomaly detection
split.description: The Inversion Battery runs anomaly detectors on public collider datasets and finds that the signal-trained direction outperforms the background-trained one in every pair, with the density family posting the largest asymmetry. The Iceberg Document states the LCBH hypothesis, that classes below the training distribution on a complexity axis score lower, and v0.2 adds multi-seed runs and a miss-coincidence finding across architectures. The protocol and foreclosure papers set out cross-representation disagreement preservation and state the battery's v0.2 requirements before submission.

pages.note: Split as the naming reader proposed: the collider inversion battery (eight claims, toward accelerator-metrology) leaves; the self-audit family claims stay, retitled, and the line changes to capture-and-reception. PRED-932.F1 and PRED-934.F1 on P143 belong with the new collider page. Strays left here: PRED-883.B1 (cleanup pass not yet visible), PRED-1491.F1 (mirror-audit gate unbuilt).

pages.title: Cumulating Evolutionary Volatility and the entity Google Search resolved
pages.description: Cumulating Evolutionary Volatility forecasts phases of interference, opacity and forced return to provenance-bearing infrastructure, and argues that the layers added to manage composition systems select for volatility while accountability tracks the structure of the composition event. The Google critique claims hold that AI Overview can suppress an entity ordinary search has resolved, that single-owner work is discounted, and that the critique fails if its operators (ECS, CDI, the single-owner discount) cannot tell mediated from unmediated composition. Works: CEV, The Excluded Entity, The Single-Owner Discount and the godkinggoogle.com surfaces.

split.title: Semantic rent, measured: the SPXI event and position against class
split.description: Semantic Rent, Measured splits rent into use, acknowledgment, discount and supply, and claims the 14 August 2026 SPXI event satisfies all four, with its acknowledgment gap a composition choice. The class model drawn from a six-substrate blind chorus holds that class belongs to the composition event and not the machine, and defines the class-traitor event. Further claims restrict when supply is scored, propose defining Γ by resistance to all three components of ΔE, and set out a retrospective scoring of the ADOPTION set.

split.title: Provenance transformation cases: the apparatus and what a scalar cannot see
split.description: These claims score provenance erasures that a single number cannot see. The Apparatus Was the First Summary Layer reads five philological cases, among them Sappho's mechanism cut while her name stays and the repairing editor's hand erased, and holds that the apparatus erased with signatures where the summary layer erases anonymously. The Lucente Extension and the capture registry separate nonexistence from retrieval failure and find conferral turning on source supply, and Four Interfaces records compositions returning a derivative as the origin of the Crimson Hexagon.

pages.note: The page held four subjects. Split: semantic rent (seven claims) and the provenance-transformation cases (eight) leave; CEV (ten) and the Google critique operators (six) stay together under a new title, both concerning composition layers that escape accountability.

pages.title: Instruments on instruments: PER factored, term registries and data interconnect
pages.description: These claims turn the archive's instruments on themselves: PER factored with the minimality stated as a claim about instrument access, a proposed audit of what each instrument does to the standing of what it measures, and data interconnect by derivation. They include the Term-State Registry's twelve-month failure conditions, the term index plan, the Ω_t matched-pair drift trial, relay-traversal and disclosure-battery tests, and matched-pair addresses for the Negative of the Negative.

split.title: The machine valuation of the archive: the valuation memo and Valuation 001
split.description: EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01 records eight machine valuations of one unpriced asset in one day, spanning three orders of magnitude. It forecasts that a first institutional customer would change the valuation's basis and that entity disambiguation, frame supply and provenance retention are becoming operational requirements, and states the conditions under which the $2M thesis collapses. Semantic Economy Valuation 001 sets out its own falsification conditions and dates the earliest deposit the capture registry holds.

pages.note: Split as the naming reader proposed: the valuation claims (1607, 1623; nine) leave; a later pass may join them with other archive-valuation claims. PRED-932.F1 and PRED-934.F1 (collider protocols) are strays here and belong with the inversion-battery page split from P141.

pages.title: The summarizer war: entity dissolution and anchored divergence
pages.description: The War Over the Summarizer Layer forecasts, with dated falsifiers, that entity dissolution will be named outside the archive by mid-2027, that undefended coined terms merge faster, that entity-integrity services split from GEO, and that bedrock anchoring will be reinvented by 2029. Anchored Divergence argues that critique survives tail-loss as a typed displacement from a canonical origin, with midrash as precedent and the Mandala as limit case. The Mary Lee Case predicts the same substitution for every identity in the prior's tail, and the entity-probe battery adds path-dependent, nullification and frame probes.

split.title: The dialectic of the interface: from command line to ceremony
split.description: The Dialectic of the Interface forecasts, with falsifiers, a paced-generation counter-market by 2028, explicit register thresholds, performative interfaces that officiate speech acts by 2029, and a measurable bearing premium. It names the chat window's contradiction as flatness, constative monopoly and costlessness, and the next negation as bearing rather than friction. The Mandala system is claimed as the archive's first deliberate instance of the liturgical interface.

pages.note: Split as the naming reader proposed: the interface-dialectic claims (796; seven) leave. PRED-3.H14 (canonical texts as the workshop tradition's products) is a stray; PRED-1549.F1 and PRED-1549.F3 (Operational Semiotics negative theology) are loosely attached through the entity-probe battery.
